title: Law to raise parking fines for big companies
summary: This bill would require the Department of Finance to charge higher-earning businesses larger reduced fines than smaller businesses in its voluntary stipulated fine and commercial abatement parking ticket programs. Companies earning over $10 million a year would pay a higher reduced rate, with a sliding scale for those earning between $5 million and $10 million, while the smallest businesses keep the lowest rate. The law would take effect 120 days after enactment.
